title: Express Entry Immigration Draws
description: Schema for Canadian Express Entry immigration draw data from Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC)

classes.description: CSS class name for styling the data table when displayed on web pages

rounds.description: Array of Express Entry invitation rounds/draws

items.description: Individual Express Entry draw round information

drawNumber.description: Unique sequential identifier number for the Express Entry draw

drawNumberURL.description: HTML anchor tag with hyperlink to the official IRCC draw details page

drawDate.description: Date when the Express Entry draw was conducted (YYYY-MM-DD format)

drawDateFull.description: Human-readable formatted date of the draw (e.g., 'December 17, 2025')

drawName.description: Category or type of draw (e.g., 'French language proficiency', 'All programs', 'Healthcare workers')

drawSize.description: Total number of Invitations to Apply (ITAs) issued in this draw

drawCRS.description: Minimum Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) score required to receive an invitation in this draw

mitext.description: HTML link to the official Ministerial Instruction document for this specific draw

DrawText1.description: HTML link to view the complete text of the Ministerial Instruction

drawText2.description: List of immigration programs included in this draw (e.g., Federal Skilled Worker Program, Canadian Experience Class, Federal Skilled Trades Program)

drawDateTime.description: Precise date and time when the draw was conducted, including UTC timezone

drawCutOff.description: Cut-off date and time for Express Entry profile creation to be eligible for this draw (UTC)

drawDistributionAsOn.description: Date when the CRS score distribution snapshot was captured for reporting

dd1.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 600 and above

dd2.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 501-600

dd3.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 451-500

dd4.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 401-450

dd5.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 351-400

dd6.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 301-350

dd7.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 251-300

dd8.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 201-250

dd9.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 151-200

dd10.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 101-150

dd11.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 51-100

dd12.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 1-50

dd13.description: Number of candidates in Express Entry pool with CRS score 0 (no score assigned)

dd14.description: Additional score range or candidate category (varies by draw type and date)

dd15.description: Additional score range or candidate category (varies by draw type and date)

dd16.description: Additional score range or candidate category (varies by draw type and date)

dd17.description: Additional score range or candidate category (varies by draw type and date)

dd18.description: Total number of candidates in the Express Entry pool at the time of score distribution capture
